According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple is undergoing a major reshuffle of its retail stores to pave the way for an upcoming lineup of home products. Apple is expected to launch a new-generation HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K as early as this autumn, but based on multiple indicators, a third and even more important product appears to be on the horizon.

Apple has accumulated a substantial backlog of home products yet to be released, primarily because the redesigned Siri has experienced repeated engineering delays. Now that the Siri overhaul is finally complete, the market can finally look forward to the official debut of these new products after years without updates.

Earlier reports indicated that Apple would lead with an all-new HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K, while the company's first smart home hub (also referred to by outsiders as a HomePod with a display, or HomePad) would likely arrive a bit later.

However, based on the direction of retail store preparations, this smart home hub is expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV and HomePod mini. The following is an excerpt from the Power On newsletter:

Of course, everything will be revealed at Apple's September event. But based on existing reports, we may see Apple unveil an all-new smart home hub in the not-too-distant future, together with a new-generation Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini supporting Siri AI.

Summary

According to various reports, the Apple smart home hub will feature a 7-inch square display and come in two versions: one with a built-in speaker, and another with built-in magnets for easy wall-mounting. The product will run an entirely new operating system, with a home screen that supports widgets, can be used for FaceTime calls, and will serve as the hub for all smart home accessories and Siri. On the hardware side, it will be powered by an A18 chip.

Another new rumour about the Apple home product lineup is that the new-generation Apple TV 4K may come with a redesigned Siri Remote, though the specific changes remain unclear.

Are you interested in the new home products? Which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
